hcom.source_scope: Canonical vendor interface/source list matches the Markdown and decision JSON; hashed sources below cover the three files used for fixed-window measurement semantics

column_predicates.delivered_metadata: Message rows with a present/non-null stored msg_delivered_to value, including serialized empty lists []; 2096 is stored-field metadata, not messages with a recipient or proof of delivery
column_predicates.stored_recipient_members: Sum of recipient-list members in the stored delivery metadata; not distinct delivered messages or recipient-role acceptance
column_predicates.cc_recipient_cross_check: The CC delta read reports 1612 messages with a recipient, versus 2096 with stored delivery metadata; no frozen count is changed

hcom.projection_digest_scope: Logical selected metadata, not database bytes; original full projection is not published. Later live delivery/current-row changes can change its digest.
mapping_rules: Ready/failed/blocked: exact life_batch_id -> native batch; instance must be in native instances array; use recorded batch tool/tag.
Status and instance sender: exact instance plus native created_at<=event<=stop/read-snapshot lifespan; require session identity match when emitted; conflicts/missing labels stay unknown.
All147 overlapping lifespans have a matching native batch tool/tag;0 missing,0 conflicting. No name-prefix or current-only historical inference.
selection_sql: SELECT id,timestamp,instance,life_action,life_by,life_batch_id,life_reason='killed',json_extract(data,'$.tag'),json_extract(data,'$.tool'),json_extract(data,'$.instances'),json_extract(data,'$.snapshot.tag'),json_extract(data,'$.snapshot.tool'),json_extract(data,'$.snapshot.created_at'),json_extract(data,'$.snapshot.session_id'),json_extract(data,'$.snapshot.name'),json_extract(data,'$.launched'),json_extract(data,'$.failed') FROM events_v WHERE type='life' AND id<=? ORDER BY id;
SELECT name,tag,tool,created_at,session_id FROM instances ORDER BY name;
SELECT id,timestamp,instance,status_val,json_extract(data,'$.session') FROM events_v WHERE type='status' AND timestamp>=? AND timestamp<? AND id<=? ORDER BY id;

SELECT id,timestamp,instance,msg_from,msg_sender_kind,msg_intent,msg_reply_to,msg_reply_to_local,msg_delivered_to FROM events_v WHERE type='message' AND timestamp>=? AND timestamp<? AND id<=? ORDER BY id;
limits: Native lifecycle/message/status counts are not tool_result, model success, organic trigger or completed-task counts.
Target-role use is distinct from initiating-role use; CC/co-op initiation is unknown.
Window uses retained current event store; no archive recovery is claimed.
Unrecorded intermediate tag changes remain unmeasured.
Reply/delivery metadata concerns messages created in the window, not response/delivery timing or recipient-role acceptance.
Reason killed includes already-dead/untracked cleanup and is not independent successful process termination.
failed_queries_retained: Alias ambiguity in metadata key probe, corrected before role claims.
Batch-target probe assumed objects; native array contains strings; malformed-JSON probe corrected.
hcom.independent_observation: Coordinator directly reproduced fixed-window type/lifecycle totals and all34 stopped/killed target-role totals.
